purpose: Negative results. Catalogues that were named in the acquisition brief or looked like plausible sources but that do NOT exist at the identifier probed, or exist but do not contain member-galaxy data. Recorded so that no substitute is silently passed off as the requested catalogue.
vizier_trap_check_method: Every VizieR asu-tsv pull was verified by parsing the response body: skip '#' comment lines, then require a header line, a units line, a '---' separator line and at least one data row. The generic VizieR error page returns HTTP 200 and echoes the requested -source string back, so echoing alone is NOT a validity test; the data-row count is. A control probe of a deliberately invalid identifier is kept as TRAPTEST_nonexistent.raw.tsv.

control_probe.conclusion: HTTP 200 with the identifier echoed but zero data rows. This is the generic-page trap. Kept as evidence that the detector fires.

not_found.probed: VizieR TAP description search for 'MACS J0717'; VizieR positional metadata search at 109.3983 +37.7461 r=8 arcmin; arXiv search for MACS J0717 Sersic / structural parameters
not_found.result: NO PUBLISHED SINGLE-SERSIC MEMBER CATALOGUE FOUND for this cluster. Granata et al. 2026 covers only A2744, AS1063, M0416 and M1149 and deliberately excludes M0717. For M0717 only non-parametric shape proxies are available: SExtractor theta / Aimg / Bimg / FRad from Shipley+2018, and theta / a / b / rf from Molino+2017. These are NOT Sersic fits and must not be labelled as such.
